text:
You need a clean, accurate list of 50+ industrial building construction companies in London with full contact and LinkedIn details, and I can help build that efficiently.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I have 5 years of experience working with SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. For this kind of lead generation and data collection work, I focus on accuracy, consistency, and making sure every record is structured in a way that’s easy to use right away.

I’ve also worked on a marketing attribution analysis project for Verdant Skincare in the e-commerce space, where I built a model that joined ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit. That work helped reallocate 18% of the ad budget and brought customer acquisition cost down 12% the next quarter. It’s a good example of the kind of careful data handling and clean reporting I bring to list-building tasks as well.

For your project, I would collect and organize the details you listed for each company:
- First Name
- Last Name
- Company Name
- Company Address
- Company Phone No
- Website URL
- Email Address
- Owner’s LinkedIn

I understand that this kind of lead list needs to be usable, not just complete, so I would keep the data organized clearly and clean it as I go to reduce duplication, missing fields, or formatting issues. If any fields are harder to confirm, I would make that clear rather than guessing, so you can trust the final list.

If you’d like, I can also format the output in a simple spreadsheet-ready structure so it’s easy for your team to review, filter, and start outreach from immediately.

I’m interested in helping with this project and would be glad to get started.
